notes: Power tree for USB supply (5 V on TYPEC_5V): USB1 -> U6 load switch -> VBUS -> nPM1300 (U2) -> VSYS (follows VBUS) -> BUCK2 3.3 V (VSYS_3V3: nRF54LM20A, flash, RGB LED, level translator, SAMD11 through the U3 load switch), LDO1 3.3 V from LDO1_IN (VSYS through R14; IMU&MIC_3V3: IMU through FB3, microphone through FB4) and TPS628438 (U1) 3.3 V (3V3_OUT, header pin only).
On battery, VSYS = VBAT (3.0-4.2 V) and the SAMD11 debugger is off (U3 enabled from VBUS). The battery charge current (nPM1300 charger, set by firmware) is not included as a load on VSYS.
Designer notes in the schematic (sheet 03 Power) give the rail ratings: VBUS 2 A, VSYS 1 A, VSYS_3V3 200 mA, LDO1_IN / IMU&MIC_3V3 100 mA, VSYS_3V3 -> SAMD11_3V3 50 mA, 3V3_OUT 600 mA.

Open: external loads on the header pins 3V3 (3V3_OUT, up to 600 mA) and VBUS (U7) are unknown and not included (kisi gaps: ic-loads U7); VBAT has no voltage in this USB-case tree (kisi gaps: rails-without-voltage VBAT); the efficiencies of BUCK2 and U1 use kisi's default of 85 % (estimate; kisi gaps: regulator-efficiency); the laminate values are not filled in; the capacitors' rated voltages and dielectrics come from their own Voltage Rating and Dielectric fields (no PI_CAP needed).
